rating_import_enabled.label: Import ratings from file tags
rating_import_enabled.description: Use a rating already stored in the files to set the favorite state. Off by default; enabling it re-reads the library once.

rating_favorite_threshold.label: Rating to import as a favorite
rating_favorite_threshold.description: Tracks and albums rated at or above this value are imported as favorites (0 = unrated, 10 = 5 stars).

rating_dislike_threshold.label: Rating to import as a dislike
rating_dislike_threshold.description: Tracks and albums rated at or below this value are imported as dislikes (0 = unrated, 10 = 5 stars).

rating_popm_scale.label: How ID3 ratings are read
rating_popm_scale.description: Taggers disagree about what a POPM value means. Choose the one your library was tagged with.

rating_tag_scale.label: How RATING values are read
rating_tag_scale.description: How the Vorbis RATING field and the MP4 RATING tag are read.

content_type.description: The type of content to expect in the media folder(s)

library_sync_tracks.label: Import tracks/files into the Music Assistant library
library_sync_tracks.description:
Define how/if you want to import tracks/files from the filesystem into the Music Assistant Library. 
When not importing into the library, they can still be manually browsed using the Browse feature. 

Please note that by adding a Track into the Music Assistant library, the track artists and album will always be imported as well.

library_sync_playlists.label: Import playlists (m3u files) into the Music Assistant library
library_sync_playlists.description:
Define how/if you want to import playlists (m3u files) from the filesystem into the Music Assistant Library. 
When not importing into the library, they can still be manually browsed using the Browse feature.

library_sync_podcasts.label: Import Podcasts(files) into the Music Assistant library
library_sync_podcasts.description:
Define how/if you want to import Podcasts(files) from the filesystem into the Music Assistant Library. 
When not importing into the library, they can still be manually browsed using the Browse feature.

library_sync_audiobooks.label: Import Audiobooks(files) into the Music Assistant library
library_sync_audiobooks.description:
Define how/if you want to import Audiobooks(files) from the filesystem into the Music Assistant Library. 
When not importing into the library, they can still be manually browsed using the Browse feature.
